integrity: The stated formulas and continuum theorem have a mathematical proof and reproducible rational endpoint checks; independent verification and historical priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only degree-at-most-one L2 projection with radial beta weights on a Euclidean unit ball is considered.
The kernel and unweighted integer-effective-dimension endpoint formula have existing spherical-projection antecedents, and are not claimed as new.
The distinctive claimed contribution is the strict continuum likelihood-ratio ordering and unique overshoot threshold; its precise decimal value is not needed for the rigorous interval (12,13).
Bibliographic priority is provisional because older Jacobi-integral and ball-projection sources could contain equivalent real-parameter comparisons.
title: A unique weighted-ball positivity boundary for affine least-squares projection
